name: cliban-flow
description: Cliban-native workflow skills, with two ways onto the board: explore a feature into a shared design and grill it into tickets on a milestone, or triage a bug report into a ticket and diagnose its root cause. Both converge on executing a single ticket or orchestrating a whole milestone end-to-end. Carries the cliban workflow contract (where specs, plans, and lessons live). Requires the cliban plugin for CLI mechanics
